quarterly_data.signal: Management: the Middle East conflict had minimal impact on the General Industry segment in 1Q; there was a direct impact on demand in EMEA, which was also hit by rising raw material, transportation and energy costs. Higher raw material, packaging and logistics costs in Japan were passed through to customers, so there was almost no deterioration in the business's cost-of-sales ratio as of 1Q. Management calls the Middle East situation highly volatile and will keep monitoring the earnings impact, including 2H.
